bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹回到 $238 上方

read.en: Arm rose 2.8% on Oct 15 to $244.79 after falling to $226.54 intraday. It is below its 5-day ($251.9), 10-day ($274.2), rising 30-day ($277.1) and falling 100-day ($296.2) averages and 10% above the 200-day ($222.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and is below zero, with the histogram flattening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($300.9), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Arm 10月15日上涨 2.8%，收于 $244.79，盘中曾跌至 $226.54。股价位于 5 日（$251.9）、10 日（$274.2）、上行的 30 日（$277.1）和下行的 100 日均线（$296.2）下方，比 200 日均线（$222.9）高 10%。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，柱状图趋平；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$300.9），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The $238 support broke intraday, but the stock reversed from $226.5, just above the Sep 3 low, and closed back above it. Resistance is $252–256 (5-day average, Oct 12–13 closes), then $274–277 (10 and 30-day averages) and $296 (100-day). Support is $237.5, then $225.5–226.5 (Sep 3 and Oct 15 lows) and $223 (200-day). A close above $256 would open $274–277.
read.zh: $238 支撑盘中失守，但股价自 $226.5（略高于 9月3日低点）反转，收盘重回其上。阻力为 $252–256（5 日均线、10月12–13日收盘价），其次 $274–277（10 日和 30 日均线）和 $296（100 日均线）。支撑为 $237.5，其次 $225.5–226.5（9月3日及 10月15日低点）和 $223（200 日均线）。若收盘站上 $256，将打开至 $274–277 的空间。
